mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops falling and turns upward, weekday foot traffic and nearby discretionary spending should recover, pushing RETAIL_REC above its prior 4-week mean within four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days despite a sustained weekly increase in WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL time indicates people are staying home more; within one week this suppresses shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC relative to the previous 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after RESIDENTIAL increases by more than 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve together, commuting-linked errands and post-work shopping expand, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks more than either series would alone.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its prior 4-week mean within 28 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -30 for two consecutive weeks, access frictions persist and retail visits weaken, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -30 for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days after TRANSIT remains below -30 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS use signals weather or leisure conditions that draw households away from shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC should soften within two weeks after PARKS rises.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 points from its recent weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after PARKS rises by more than 5 points from its recent weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays near baseline while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, households are substituting toward home-centered routines without broad containment; that combination should keep RETAIL_REC below its prior 4-week mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and GROCERY_PHARM remains near baseline.

mechanism_narrative: In a restrictive regime, a small improvement in GROCERY_PHARM reflects essential-trip normalization without broader reopening, and retail leisure demand will still lag; RETAIL_REC should remain below the last 4-week mean over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM moves upward while WORKPLACES remains below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not below its prior 4-week mean within 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM rises but WORKPLACES stays below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized rebound in TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and PARKS marks broader mobility normalization; under that pattern, retail-and-recreation traffic should turn higher relative to the previous 4 weeks within four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days when TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and PARKS all improve together.
